rationale: Build on the reverse recurrent-tail baseline by compiling two training paths and using a cheaper no-recurrence path early, then enabling the proven reverse recurrent tail only in the late wallclock-critical phase. This spends more of the 600s budget on updates before switching into the export-aligned endgame, and it also fixes the chunked masked-loss accumulation bug without touching final exact int8 evaluation.
title: Tail Recurrence Warmup Curriculum
